name: Grandma Johnson Fried Rice
author: Grandma Johnson
steps: Brown meat in a little oil along with the chipped onion and green peppers.
Prepare separately 2 - 3 cups of rice - set aside.
Beat eggs and fry separately. Chop up and add to meat and onion mixture. Then add the rice and mix together in a large skillet or wok.
Mix soy sauce and water with 1 to 2 T of sugar. Pour over rice mixture and cook another 3 to 5 minuets before serving
